layout: One entirely handwritten sheet. A short centred French heading is followed by a three-line parenthetical English preliminary note, then three English body paragraphs. The first body paragraph has six manuscript lines, the second nine, and the last four. The text continues off the sheet after stems from. One unnamed hand writes the main text and interlineations. Four interlinear insertions are visible: for me above the first line, possible below it, journey above cancelled travel, and thus above its caret. Two cancellations occur: the character after a and travel. Twelve underline spans occur, mostly visibly red, with some reproduced dark/grey in the scan. A lighter archive 9 is at the lower-left corner. There are no mathematical displays, diagrams, drawings, stamps, letterhead, or independent body-margin annotations.

notes: The preliminary note calls this a possible alternative version, explains that the photocopy of the original is no longer very clear, and identifies the underlined revisions as changes made by Breen or by us.

The first body paragraph announces works of maturity after a twelve years' silence, with renewed vision and style, and describes a day-by-day account of an explorer's journey and reflections on travel, traveler, and surrounding world. Its last word life has no terminal stop.

The two forthcoming volumes are called Pursuing Stacks; the first volume is said to be subtitled The Modelizing Story, with the comma visibly inside the quotation. The page mentions a synthesis of homotopical algebra, (co)homological algebra, and topos theory, described as ripe for more than fifteen years but never yet begun.

The last paragraph places these volumes in the wider series Réflexions Mathématiques and mentions naive ideas about two new continents. It breaks off at One stems from. The page gives a count of two volumes, no page count or date. Archive corner number: 9.

brief_feedback: Whole image viewed exactly once for layout; each supplied half viewed exactly once for line-by-line comparison against both witnesses. Four unresolved places were then cropped exactly once with scripts/crop.py, enlarged to 2400 pixels, autocontrasted and sharpened: article correction/possible, opening aside arcs, closing him punctuation/thus, naive ideas quote strokes. No whole or half was reopened or enlarged, and no OCR, extraction, web source, other page, or other reader output was used. Every word and sign in the four prose blocks and heading was compared; all C-context doubt locations are covered by the ten doubt records. The 24 inventory rows cover the five text blocks, four insertions, two deletions, twelve underline spans, and the archival number; overlapping state rows are deliberate. H emph is treated as underline, struck as deletion, and -- versus --- as a typographic dash encoding rather than a collation change. H guillemets are separately reported at six spans because the page has visible paired raised quotes; supplied s/e are identified as editorial letters absent from the ink. H editorial notes are not transcribed as page text and are not doubt marks. The two explicit C uncertainty macros are retained; no C text change is proposed. The mandatory cotefile macro is added as wrapper metadata, not a manuscript reading change. No substantive mathematical proof, calculation, or consistency test was performed on this prose page; math_checks is empty.
